verdict.rationale: esp32-iphone-agent is itself an AI agent: an iPhone app that drives the phone via an ESP32 board using an OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint. Serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role, and nothing in the evidence shows it running as an MCP server. Exporting run traces for another agent to analyse is not an MCP server mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
